title: The Tooth Fairy Contract
status: concept-proposal (Creative Director, 2026-11-19; not approved; awaiting owner review)
hook_line: Theo's tooth fairy leaves a contract. I broke clause four.
first_visual: A tiny folded note under a child's pillow in moonlight, sealed with a pressed moth-wing.

beats.visual: A folded note under a pillow, moth-wing seal.
beats.vo: Theo's tooth fairy leaves a contract. I broke clause four.

beats.visual: Theo reads it proudly; Ivy smirks, coin hidden in her palm.
beats.vo: I was doing the coin myself. Obviously.

beats.visual: Clause cards: 1. Tooth under pillow by eight. 2. Light off. 3. Everyone sleeps.
beats.vo: Under the pillow. Lights off. Everyone asleep. Mostly.

beats.visual: Ivy at the door crack, peeking; the pillow lifts slightly; long fingers withdraw the tooth.
beats.vo: Clause four: no peeking. I peeked.

beats.visual: Something in the dark turns toward the crack: lamp eyes; Ivy shuts the door.
Morning: Theo shows a coin; Ivy lifts her own pillow: two coins, a note.
beats.vo: He got a coin. So did I. Two.

beats.visual: Key moment: Ivy's hand rises to her jaw; her face changes; Theo in the doorway.

ending: Ivy touches her jaw and finds a gap (no blood shown). Theo: 'You peeked, didn't you?'

originality_review: Original contract framing for a common childhood figure. The tooth fairy is public-domain folklore, with no IP character or design used. The 'peeking fee' twist is ours.
scores_basis: Initial editorial judgement, 2026-11-19. topic_demand is an estimate linked to research/WEEKLY_TREND_REPORT.md categories, not a measurement of this concept.
concept: Theo's tooth fairy leaves a contract. Ivy plans to swap the coin herself and peeks, breaking clause four. In the morning she finds two coins and a note under her own pillow: 'Double, as agreed.'

hooks.line: Theo's tooth fairy leaves a contract. I broke clause four.
hooks.first_visual: A tiny folded note under a child's pillow in moonlight, sealed with a pressed moth-wing.

hooks.line: Clause four: no peeking. Peekers pay double.
hooks.first_visual: An eye at a door crack.
A pillow corner rising in the dark.

hooks.line: Theo got his coin. So did I. Two.
hooks.first_visual: Two coins on an adult's pillow beside a tiny note.

hooks.line: Then I ran my tongue along my teeth.
hooks.first_visual: A woman's hand rising slowly to her jaw.

setting: Theo's bedroom; the hallway door crack; Ivy's pillow.
conflict: Adult scepticism against a child's ritual.
escalation: Clauses 1-3 kept; clause 4 broken; something in the dark turns toward the crack.
reveal: Two coins under her pillow: 'Double, as agreed.'
